entry.name: live.tab
entry.digest: A user interface tab/multiple button object in the style of Ableton Live.
entry.description: live.tab is used to create multiple-button and multi-column displays and interfaces.

attributes.name: active
attributes.description: Toggles the object's active state. Whenis set to 0, the mouse action does not cause output and the inactive colors are used.

attributes.name: activebgcolor
attributes.description: Sets the background color off displayed when theattribute is set to 1.

attributes.name: activebgoncolor
attributes.description: Sets the background color on displayed when theattribute is set to 1.

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.description: The string that is prepended to annotations. This shows up in the Info pane in Live, and the clue window in Max.

attributes.name: blinktime
attributes.description: Sets the blink time in milliseconds.

attributes.name: bordercolor
attributes.description: Sets the display color for theobject's border in RGBA format.

attributes.digest: Adjusted margins and padding to match Live 10

attributes.name: mode
attributes.description: Sets the text tab layout mode.

choices.label: Separate tab entries are proportionally spaced according to the text.Note: to add multiple words, use the backslash before a space (e.g. "one\ down")

attributes.name: multiline
attributes.description: Toggles allowing multiple lines of text in a tab. When set, you can resize the object to create multi-column displays.

attributes.name: param_connect
attributes.description: Establishes a two-way connection between the object and a parameter of a compatible object with parameters such asor. The object can be used to change the value of the parameter and will update if the parameter value changes. The easiest way to setis with the attribute's menu in theor the Connect submenu of the. The menu displays all available parameters of compatible objects.Setting theattribute with a message requires the target parameter's path, which is the host object's scriping name followed by two colons and the parameter name. For example, for aobject with scripting name, the path of theparameter would be. You can set a value for thebefore the host object or parameter exists, and the object will connect to the parameter once it exists. Refer to the user guide entry forfor more details.

attributes.name: parameter_mappable
attributes.description: When parameter_mappable is enabled, the object will be available for mapping to keyboard or MIDI input using the. (default = 1).

attributes.name: pictures
attributes.description: Sets the paths for pictures used when theattribute is set to 1. Bitmap images such as PNG or vectorized images (SVG) can be used.

attributes.name: usepicture
attributes.description: Toggles the use of the pictures instead of text display. Note that you need to provide enough pictures by setting theattribute properly.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.digest: Click to set a tab selection
messages.description: Clicking on a tab button will highlight and set the selection and send the tab text out the second outlet and the index out the first outlet.

messages.name: assign
messages.description: The word, followed by a floating point value, causes that value to be displayed and sent out theobject's outlet. The value, however, will not be stored. If the Parameter Visibility attribute is set to Stored Only, themessage will not add the new value to the Live application’s undo chain.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Sends the current item out the outlets.

messages.name: float
messages.digest: Display a tab item and send the current item
messages.description: The number specifies a tab item to be sent out, and causesto display that item. The items are numbered starting at 0.

messages.name: init
messages.digest: Restore and output the initial value
messages.description: Restore and output the initial value.

messages.name: int
messages.digest: Display a tab item and send the current item
messages.description: The number specifies a tab item to be sent out, and causesto display that item. The items are numbered starting at 0.

messages.name: outputvalue
messages.description: Sends the current value out the outlet.

messages.name: rawfloat
messages.digest: Store a raw normalized value, convert to real, display, and output
messages.description: A raw normalized value (between 0. and 1.) received in the inlet is converted to a real value, stored, displayed by, and the current value is sent out the outlet.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Display a menu item without triggering output
messages.description: The word, followed by a number, specifies a menu item to be displayed bywithout triggering any output.

messages.name: setsymbol
messages.digest: Display a tab item without triggering output
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol that specifies a tab item, causesto display that item, but does not cause any output.

messages.name: symbol
messages.digest: Display a tab item and report output
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol that specifies a tab item, causesto display that item and send the tab text out the second outlet and the index out the first outlet.
